plan.title: RFQ auto title for mixed-family products

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.

args.goal: On the RFQ create screen, add CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB from the CYLINDER product search and BACK FILLING as the second product, set both Delivery location values to Plant Name, leave the title field empty, and stop with the completed product sheet visible.

steps.note: Add the two specified products from different families and set their shared location, which no catalog domain step can express directly.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [RFQ] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB & more - Plant Name

steps.note: Assert that the untouched title field contains the expected mixed-family auto-generated RFQ title.
